subject: Data Engineering
title: Multi-Cloud Strategies
description: Learn Multi-Cloud Strategies in one minute.

hook.text: The CTO wants to avoid lock-in. The solution: run on AWS and GCP simultaneously. Easier said than done.

buildup.text: Multi-cloud uses services from multiple providers to reduce dependency on any single one.

discovery.text: Abstraction layers like Kubernetes, Spark, and Iceberg work across clouds, enabling portability.

twist.text: True multi-cloud doubles operational complexity. Most teams do it only for compliance or acquisition reasons.

climax.text: A pragmatic approach is cloud-portable design: use open formats but deploy to one cloud at a time.

punchline.text: Design for portability. Deploy to one cloud.

quiz.question: What is the biggest challenge of a multi-cloud strategy?
